## Weekly digest
Every Monday at 08:00 (America/Bogota) this reads the `Moving leads` sheet and emails `digest_email` a plain-text summary of the last seven days: the number of leads, their estimated value, the average, the top routes and the move types, in the team's language (`team_locale`). It sends no customer names, phones or emails. A failure alerts the operator through `errorWorkflow`, and a successful run stores no execution data.

## Compose and send the digest
`Digest input` hands `Compose digest` the config, every sheet row and the Bogota time (`$now`), so the Code node stays free of the clock. `Compose digest` keeps the rows received in the last seven days, counts them and writes the summary in `team_locale`; it throws when `digest_email` is not set, which alerts the operator. `Email digest` sends its `to`, `subject` and `text` as plain text.

nodes.name: Compose digest
nodes.notes: Why Code: one tested function keeps the last seven days of sheet rows, counts them by route and move type, and writes the summary in team_locale
